role: diagnostic probes only; no checkpoint selected for deployment
population: SEL-C0 clean-train folds 0-3; fold4=611 and B2B 581 remain unread
folds: four query-grouped out-of-fold rounds, each fold held out once, using existing sha256 modulo-five roles 0-3

selector.actions: unique V13 ranks 5-10 relative to frozen clean-lineage V8 STAY
selector.positive: D0B repair or safe_token_saving; break and no_gain are nonpositive
features: complete frozen C1 candidate feature difference
selector.deployment: select the highest-scoring unique tail per query, then switch exactly the top 1%, 2%, or 5% queries by that score; no oracle action filtering

cutoff.scope: easier unconditional 0.90 window-identifiability upper-bound probe on fixed V8 order; no previous-anchor oracle stop as feature
features: frozen query/current-prefix representation and token fraction
cutoff.decision: argmax predicted safe-window score over thirteen deployment-computable prefix states, with stable earliest-depth tie break
metrics: top-one safe-window hit among reachable orders

probe.standardization: training fold mean and standard deviation only

interpretation: negative result applies only to tested frozen features and linear diagnostic probes, not information-theoretic impossibility; positive result does not establish deployable multi-anchor cutoff
